verses.en: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?
verses.pt: Quem deu crédito à nossa pregação? e a quem se manifestou o braço do Senhor?
verses.en_web: Who has believed our message? To whom has the arm of Yahweh been revealed?
verses.en_bbe: Who would have had faith in the word which has come to our ears, and to whom had the arm of the Lord been unveiled?

verses.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.pt: Pois foi crescendo como renovo perante ele, e como raiz que sai duma terra seca; não tinha formosura nem beleza; e quando olhávamos para ele, nenhuma beleza víamos, para que o desejássemos.
verses.en_web: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.en_bbe: For his growth was like that of a delicate plant before him, and like a root out of a dry place: he had no grace of form, to give us pleasure;

verses.en: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
verses.pt: Era desprezado, e rejeitado dos homens; homem de dores, e experimentado nos sofrimentos; e, como um de quem os homens escondiam o rosto, era desprezado, e não fizemos dele caso algum.
verses.en_web: He was despised, and rejected by men; a man of suffering, and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.
verses.en_bbe: Men made sport of him, turning away from him; he was a man of sorrows, marked by disease; and like one from whom men's faces are turned away, he was looked down on, and we put no value on him.

verses.en: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
verses.pt: Verdadeiramente ele tomou sobre si as nossas enfermidades, e carregou com as nossas dores; e nós o reputávamos por aflito, ferido de Deus, e oprimido.
verses.en_web: Surely he has borne our sickness, and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.
verses.en_bbe: But it was our pain he took, and our diseases were put on him: while to us he seemed as one diseased, on whom God's punishment had come.

verses.en: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.pt: Mas ele foi ferido por causa das nossas transgressões, e esmagado por causa das nossas iniqüidades; o castigo que nos traz a paz estava sobre ele, e pelas suas pisaduras fomos sarados.
verses.en_web: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
verses.en_bbe: But it was for our sins he was wounded, and for our evil doings he was crushed: he took the punishment by which we have peace, and by his wounds we are made well.

verses.en: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.pt: Todos nós andávamos desgarrados como ovelhas, cada um se desviava pelo seu caminho; mas o Senhor fez cair sobre ele a iniqüidade de todos nós.
verses.en_web: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.en_bbe: We all went wandering like sheep; going every one of us after his desire; and the Lord put on him the punishment of us all.

verses.en: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
verses.pt: Ele foi oprimido e afligido, mas não abriu a boca; como um cordeiro que é levado ao matadouro, e como a ovelha que é muda perante os seus tosquiadores, assim ele não abriu a boca.
verses.en_web: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Men were cruel to him, but he was gentle and quiet; as a lamb taken to its death, and as a sheep before those who take her wool makes no sound, so he said not a word.

verses.en: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
verses.pt: Pela opressão e pelo juízo foi arrebatado; e quem dentre os da sua geração considerou que ele fora cortado da terra dos viventes, ferido por causa da transgressão do meu povo?
verses.en_web: He was taken away by oppression and judgment; and as for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?
verses.en_bbe: They took away from him help and right, and who gave a thought to his fate? for he was cut off from the land of the living: he came to his death for the sin of my people.

verses.en: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.pt: E deram-lhe a sepultura com os ímpios, e com o rico na sua morte, embora nunca tivesse cometido injustiça, nem houvesse engano na sua boca.
verses.en_web: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death; although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.en_bbe: And they put his body into the earth with sinners, and his last resting-place was with the evil-doers, though he had done no wrong, and no deceit was in his mouth.

verses.en: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.
verses.pt: Todavia, foi da vontade do Senhor esmagá-lo, fazendo-o enfermar; quando ele se puser como oferta pelo pecado, verá a sua posteridade, prolongará os seus dias, e a vontade do Senhor prosperará nas suas mãos.
verses.en_web: Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days, and Yahweh’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord was pleased ... see a seed, long life, ... will do well in his hand. ...

verses.en: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
verses.pt: Ele verá o fruto do trabalho da sua alma, e ficará satisfeito; com o seu conhecimento o meu servo justo justificará a muitos, e as iniqüidades deles levará sobre si.
verses.en_web: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.
verses.en_bbe: ... made clear his righteousness before men ... had taken their sins on himself.

verses.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.pt: Pelo que lhe darei o seu quinhão com os grandes, e com os poderosos repartirá ele o despojo; porquanto derramou a sua alma até a morte, e foi contado com os transgressores; mas ele levou sobre si o pecado de muitos, e pelos transgressores intercedeu.
verses.en_web: Therefore will I give him a portion with the great, and he will divide the plunder with the strong; because he poured out his soul to death, and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause he will have a heritage with the great, and he will have a part in the goods of war with the strong, because he gave up his life, and was numbered with the evil-doers; taking on himself the sins of the people, and making prayer for the wrongdoers.
